title: Following parades and the Sam Morgan band
summary: He followed parades as a boy, especially Sam Morgan's band, handing out circulars; he later played in it for six years.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Did you follow any parades in those days?

Oh, yeah. That's all we did, followed parades in them days. I mean, a strange thing, I used to hang on, follow one band more than ever. It was the Sam Morgan Jazz Band. And little did I realize then, a little old guy, eleven years old, running around the street, barefooted, that one day I was going to play in that band for six years.
Where were they playing those days?

Well, they were playing different places. I didn't go to the places they played, but I used to meet them on Sunday advertising. Oh, in the wagon. Advertising on the street, not hop on and give me a bunch of folders, or circulars in other words they call them. I would deliver them just to be out there with them, you know. Something like that hand bill of Kid Thomas? That's right, a hand bill. That's really what it was, a hand bill.
